c170947887.notes: Back-lit cut-metal entrance pillar of a housing development in Wainuiomata, Lower Hutt (no camera location); night shot, white serif capitals under a white feather/pod motif, with a large glowing green koru (fern) design below. Black background, no other text. Māori: 'the water spring'.

c171479219.notes: Two-sided V-shaped church board on teal posts, Wainuiomata, Lower Hutt (no camera location); both faces carry the same text (left face is clearer; the right face has peeled letters, e.g. 'CHRISTIA' and 'SAMC A'). Samoan lines are arched and written without the glottal-stop mark (FAAPOTOPOTOGA). The circular crest has tiny text 'O LE EKALESIA FAAPOTOPOTOGA KERISIANO ... I SAMOA'. The service-times panel (Sunday School 9.30 am, Morning Service 11.00 am, ...) and 'Minister : Rev. Henry / Phone' (rest blanked) are secondary. The Commons description spells it 'EKELASIA', but the sign reads EKALESIA.

c171603282.notes: White-to-purple gradient board on two grey posts on a lawn in Wainuiomata (no camera location); dappled tree shadows over the text. The phone number appears to be cut short ('04 564' followed by a blank), and a vertical bar separates it from the street name THE STRAND. A Māori carved-house (wharenui) logo is in the centre.

c171667206.notes: Large white board with red serif capitals on white posts against blue sky, Wainuiomata (no camera location); the Samoan line is arched. Rust streaks at the bolts. Below is a navy service-times panel in Samoan and English ('SAUNIGA OLE VAIASO / Aso Gafua 6:00pm ...', 'PRAYER MEETING', 'SAUNIGA OLE ASO SA', 'SUNDAY SERVICE') and 'REV. / PH: (04) / MOB:' with blank fields; the triangular logo has small text 'OLE MEA SILI UA IA TE I TATOU LE ATUA'. These are secondary reads.

c153075768.notes: Shared church signboard on two posts, Albany Village, Auckland (camera -36.7254, 174.6962), frontal. Top maroon panel is the target (Holy Cross Anglican Church); the white strip has two empty letter rails. The lower blue panel is a Korean congregation that shares the site: small stacked '기독교 / 대한감리회' beside a shield logo, then the larger Korean name in a brush-style font. Both names are mappable.

c167686926.notes: Raised white Art-Deco letters on a recessed duck-egg-blue panel on the stucco wall of the Mountain Court apartments, Mount Eden, Auckland (camera -36.8741, 174.7614); frontal. Written as one run 'MOUNTAINCOURT' (tall initial M and C, the rest in small capitals) with no visible space between the words; the name is Mountain Court. A small unit number '3' by the door is a distractor.
